properties.value: TLS provider for the zombienet backchannel's HTTPS traffic. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: rustls 0.19.1 — the TLS provider in this build (telemetry/WS stack). Supports TLS 1.3 and 1.2 with classical-only key establishment (ECDHE X25519/P-256 via ring); no post-quantum or hybrid groups exist in this 2020-era release. Sessions opened through it are harvest-now-decrypt-later exposed. Migration: TLS 1.3 hybrid X25519MLKEM768 (requires a modern rustls).
